---
title: "Media Viewer Tool Options Bar"
format: html
---

## Overview

The Media Viewer shows a horizontal **tool options bar** directly above the horizontal pixel ruler. It displays contextual controls for the active tool selected in the left `MediaToolStrip_Widget`.

## Layout

The `Media_Widget` grid uses three rows:

| Col 0 | Col 1 | Col 2 |
|-------|-------|-------|
| Tool strip (row span 3) | Tool options bar (col span 2) | |
| | Ruler corner | Horizontal ruler |
| | Vertical ruler | Graphics view |

## Components

| Component | Role |
|-----------|------|
| `MediaToolOptionsBar_Widget` | Container with `QStackedWidget` (empty placeholder or tool page); fixed height always reserved |
| `SelectToolOptions_Widget` | Select-tool page: key filter combo and pick radius spinbox |
| `PenToolOptions_Widget` | Pen-tool page: append-endpoint combo and usage instructions |
| `EraserToolOptions_Widget` | Eraser-tool page: hover-circle radius slider/spinbox |

## Select Tool Filter

`SelectToolOptions_Widget` reads enabled features from `MediaWidgetState::enabledFeatures()` for **line**, **mask**, and **point** keys only. The combo rebuilds when `featureEnabledChanged` fires (via `DisplayOptionsRegistry::setVisible()` from the feature table). The combo offers:

- **All enabled features** — default (`SelectToolPrefs::filter_to_key == false`)
- One entry per enabled key — sets `filter_key` and `filter_data_type` in `SelectToolPrefs`

Preferences are stored in `MediaWidgetStateData::select_prefs` and exposed via `selectPrefs()` / `setSelectPrefs()`.

**Pick radius** (`SelectToolPrefs::pick_radius_px`, default 15 px) controls the scene-pixel distance threshold used by `findBestEntityAtPosition()` for all data types.

Canvas left-click selection uses `Media_Window::findBestEntityAtPosition()` when the Select tool is active. The filter restricts candidate keys before closest-hit ranking across enabled line, mask, and point features.

When `DataManager` deletes a key, `Media_Widget::_pruneRemovedFeatures()` removes stale display options (emitting `displayOptionsRemoved`), which triggers a combo rebuild. If the active filter targeted the deleted key, it resets to **All enabled features**.

## Pen Tool

`PenToolOptions_Widget` exposes the append-endpoint policy and usage instructions. When the Pen tool is active:

- Use the **Select** tool first to pick a line entity on the canvas.
- Choose **Append to:** tip, base, or nearest endpoint (stored in `LineInteractionPrefs::append_endpoint`).
- **Ctrl+click** appends a point to the selected line at the configured endpoint (`MediaLine_Widget::_addPointToLine`).
- **Alt+click** deletes the nearest vertex within `SelectToolPrefs::pick_radius_px` (`MediaLine_Widget::_deleteNearestVertexFromLine`).
- **Right-click** on the selected line opens the line context menu.

## Eraser Tool

`EraserToolOptions_Widget` configures the Eraser hover-circle preview. When the Eraser tool is active:

- **Eraser size** (`EraserToolPrefs::radius_px`, default 10 px, range 1–50) drives `Media_Window::setHoverCircleRadius()`.
- `Media_Widget::_syncEraserHoverCircle()` enables the hover circle on the canvas.
- Actual erase gestures are not implemented in this phase.

## Wiring

`Media_Widget::_wireToolUi()` connects:

- `MediaToolStrip_Widget::activeToolChanged` → `MediaToolOptionsBar_Widget::setActiveTool`
- `MediaWidgetState` → tool option widgets via `MediaToolOptionsBar_Widget::setState`
- `MediaWidgetState::eraserPrefsChanged` → `Media_Widget::_syncEraserHoverCircle`
